newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen flat on lingering economic worry.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen flat on lingering economic worry.

text.p: Thai stocks were seen flat on lack of fresh incentives and persistent worries about the current economic slowdown, brokers said.
The SET index on Wednesday close down 3.70 points at 552.87 on 2.65 billion baht turnover.
"I don't think there would be much movement in the share prices today," said one broker at a foreign brokerage.
"There remains a lack of good news to trigger buying while economy is still showing no sign of recovery in the near term," the broker said.
